resources.string: Turn on Mika in your system Accessibility settings so it can read the interface and operate apps for you. You choose whether to grant access. After this, configure your AI model; advanced phone control can be enabled later.
Cannot enable it? Open App info to allow restricted settings.

Let Mika operate apps on a separate background screen. Tap below to start guided setup of Developer options, USB debugging, Wireless debugging and pairing. Chat, web and file tasks are available without this step.
This setup is free and optional. You still enter the screen-lock password and confirm system prompts yourself.
